sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • The last, still-being-typed word now triggers its synonyms via prefix, so live results appear before the word is finished. Previously an unfinished word was stemmed to a different root that no longer matched a synonym rule, so a query like "iPhone 14 батаре" returned nothing even though "iPhone 14 батарея" found products listed under the synonym "аккумулятор/АКБ". A completed word behaves exactly as before, and an unrelated trailing word does not over-expand. New "Match synonyms while typing" toggle (General tab, on by default).
